sentences.text:
NO. NOTE 1. 06.01.2025 SRK, J  Learned Assistant Public Prosecutor for  State takes notice for respondent No.1.
Notice before admission.

Learned counsel for the petitioners is permitted to take out personal notice to respondent No.2 by registered post with acknowledgment due and file proof of service before the Registry within a period of three (3) weeks.
Heard.

A perusal of material on record goes to show that originally, a case was registered against the petitioners/accused Nos.6 and 7 and others for the offences punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
During the course of investigation, police deleted the names SL.
OFFICE
DATE ORDER NO. NOTE of petitioners
from the list of accused
and filed charge sheet against accused Nos.1 to 4.
Thereafter, the de facto complainant filed petition vide Crl.M.P.No.747 of 2024 on the file of the Judicial Magistrate of First Class-cum-Principal Junior Civil Judge, Srikakulam.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate of First Class-cum-Principal Junior Civil Judge, Srikakulam
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Vide Order, dated 26.02.2024, learned Magistrate allowed the petition and took cognizance of the offences against accused Nos.1 to 4 along with petitioners herein/accused Nos.6 and 7.

A perusal of the sworn affidavit filed by the de facto complainant in Crl.M.P.No.747 of 2024, it was alleged that police intentionally with a view to escape the petitioners herein/accused Nos.6 and 7 in the crime, not investigated the case in a proper way.
Even going by the averment contained in the petition goes to show that the petitioners/accused Nos.6 and 7 were alleged to have supported accused Nos.1 to 4.
Except the said accusation there is no other material on SL.
OFFICE DATE ORDER NO.
NOTE record connecting the petitioners/accused Nos.6 and 7 to the crime.
